content.question: When does this sandbox program end?
content.answer: The sandbox program ends on December 31, 2026.

content.question: How do I join the sandbox program?
content.answer: Ask in #pixie-sandbox and a helper will add you.

sources.name: Sandbox Rules
sources.content: The sandbox is a staging area for testing Pixie. Real YSWS deadlines do not apply here. Questions about refunds are always escalated to a human.
